patthana16.28:1.1: upādinnupādāniyaṃ hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na upādinnupādāniyo nahetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: upādinnupādāniyaṃ hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na anupādinnupādāniyo na hetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: upādinnupādāniyaṃ hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na anupādinnaanupādāniyo na hetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: upādinnupādāniyaṃ hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na upādinnupādāniyo na hetu ca na anupādinnaanupādāniyo na hetu ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā: upādinnupādāniyaṃ hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na anupādinnupādāniyo na hetu ca na anupādinnaanupādāniyo na hetu ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā: pañca.
patthana16.28:2.1: anupādinnupādāniyaṃ hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na upādinnupādāniyo na hetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: tīṇi.
patthana16.28:3.1: anupādinnaanupādāniyaṃ hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na anupādinnaanupādāniyo na hetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: pañca.
patthana16.28:5.1: upādinnupādāniyaṃ nahetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na anupādinnupādāniyo na nahetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: tīṇi.
patthana16.28:6.1: hetuyā nava. saṅkiliṭṭhasaṅkilesikattika hetuduke nasaṅkiliṭṭhasaṅkilesikattika nahetudukaṃ
